login.description: Elegant splash background with Somnio.Co Atelier logo. Form for role selection and login.
login.layout_rules: Full screen image background with dark gradient overlay (bg-black/60). Form items stacked vertically.

dashboard.description: Role-based entry point (Admin, Manufacturer, Associate, Client). Displays high-level stats and assigned/pending jobs.
dashboard.layout_rules: Top header with user profile & role. Section titles in uppercase serif. Flat cards for job items.

job_detail.description: The core 26-step tracking interface. Organized in 5 collapsible accordion phases.
job_detail.layout_rules: Sticky header with Job ID and high-level progress bar. Scrollable body with phase headers and vertical stepper for steps.

step_action_modal.description: Screen/Modal for a specific step to upload photos, add notes, and view timestamps.
step_action_modal.layout_rules: Dark matte surface. Clean file upload dropzone. Full width primary button to Mark as Complete.

login_background.description: Jeweler meticulously working on a necklace, perfect for login screen background.

client_view_hero.description: Close-up of luxury silver rings with blue gemstones.

phase_origins_sketch.description: Gold jewelry set with design sketch.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo app. Please ensure you configure routing via Expo Router.
Nativewind is expected for styling; map the provided tailwind classes appropriately.
Implement Role-Based Access Control logic for the 4 roles: Admin, Manufacturer, Associate, Client.
The 26 steps should be grouped exactly as requested into Phase I to V.
All timestamps for completed steps must be converted and displayed in China/Shanghai timezone (CST) as requested.
Admin area should exclusively allow uploading shipping airway bills and customs documents for step 24-26.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Ensure image uploads are mocked or use device storage/camera capabilities cleanly.
Avoid generic SaaS UI; stick strictly to the dark/gold luxury aesthetic outlined.
